meta.name: create-a-plan
meta.description: Create a researched Prime Agent plan before implementation. Use for broad or risky repo changes needing 5 to 10 planning questions, web research, reviewer or criticizer settings, and bounded refinement; exclude direct implementation-only, factual/explanation, trivial command-only, or explicit no-plan requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 动手改代码前先调研并产出实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要动大范围代码库却拿不准改动影响
copy.tagline_en: Research and produce an implementation plan before changing code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to plan a broad or risky repo change before writing code

howto.what: 改动代码前先规划:只读检查仓库后,一次一个地问你5–10个问题,需要时上网查资料,写出PLAN_v1.md,最多可改5轮。
howto.when: 当你要对仓库做较大或高风险改动,希望动手前先有研究过的计划时触发。例如涉及多文件修改、架构调整、外部 API 等。

say.text: 我要重构登录模块,先做个计划。
say.note: 它会先检查仓库再提问,最后生成计划文件。

say.text: 项目要换数据库驱动,风险不小,帮我规划。
say.note: 它会逐题确认需求后产出计划。

say.text: 想把上传改为异步,影响大,先规划。
say.note: 它会做网上调研并给出细化方案。

howto.what_en: Before changing code, it plans: after a read-only check of the repo, it asks 5–10 questions one at a time, performs web research if needed, writes a PLAN_v1.md, and may refine it up to 5 rounds.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want a researched plan before a large or risky repo change, e.g., multi-file edits, architecture shifts, or external API changes.

say_en.text: I want to refactor the login module; plan it first.
say_en.note: It checks the repo, asks questions, then generates a plan file.

say_en.text: Switching database drivers, risky; plan this.
say_en.note: It confirms requirements one by one, then produces the plan.

say_en.text: Making upload async; big impact, plan first.
say_en.note: It does web research and offers a refined plan.
